record.question: Which of the following is the most effective strategy to minimize dispensing errors in a busy high patient load pharmacy setting?

Storing look-alike/sound-alike (LASA) drugs together for convenience

record.question: Why do some clinical trials include Phase 0 (microdosing studies)?
options: To include the study of more than one drug
To reduce the cost and time of drug development process
record.explanation: Answer B: To reduce the cost and time of drug development process. Phase 0 microdosing studies can provide early human pharmacokinetic information with limited exposure, potentially reducing time and cost before larger trials. Source/context note: Phase 0 is exploratory and does not assess efficacy or establish safety for therapeutic doses.
